provider.name: Orthoptera Species File
provider.organization_type: global orthopteran taxonomy, nomenclature, synonymy, typification, bibliography, distribution, fossil, image, specimen, web-service, and download infrastructure
provider.description: Orthoptera Species File is a global taxonomic reference for grasshoppers, crickets, katydids, wetas, and other Orthoptera. It provides accepted names, synonyms, ranks, classifications, authorship, original combinations, typification, type localities, distributions, fossil records, bibliography, images, specimens, statistics, downloads, and best-effort machine interfaces through the Species File platform.
institutional_context: Museums, universities, taxonomic specialists, photographers, and collection repositories
Global biodiversity and nomenclatural infrastructures including Catalogue of Life, GBIF, ZooBank, BHL, and TDWG

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Orthoptera Species File documentation, classification, names, synonyms, typification, references, distributions, fossil data, specimens, images, searches, web services, downloads, schemas, quality workflows, licenses, citations, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Orthoptera Species File, its editors and taxonomic specialists, official Species File documentation, original taxonomic literature, nomenclatural authorities, museum type specimens, official releases, and cited external sources remain authoritative for names, status, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
